name: Sweetie Belle
source: [url=/c11574]Rarity[/url]'s younger sister, Sweetie Belle is a light grey unicorn pony with a pink and purple mane and tail and light green eyes. Sweetie Belle tends to be a slower thinker than her friends [url=/c11585]Apple Bloom[/url] and [url=/c11587]Scootaloo[/url], but is as excitable as them and will readily follow their lead. Though she wants to be a designer like Rarity, her inexperience and clumsiness prove to be a hindrance when she tries to assist in the shop, she has a talent for singing and songwriting.
